id: 999-倫斯特對布萊恩·博魯的反抗
theater: 基爾代爾郡阿德克勞山口

battle.name: 倫斯特對布萊恩·博魯的反抗
battle.theater: 基爾代爾郡阿德克勞山口
battle.brief: 公元999年12月30日，布萊恩·博魯聯同至高王梅爾·謝克奈爾，在基爾代爾郡阿德克勞的格倫馬瑪山口擊潰倫斯特與都柏林的聯軍，馬爾·穆爾達被俘，翌年元旦都柏林被攻破焚燒。卡面羅馬弩砲並不在此役現場；它對應的是同一命題的另一條路徑——拆城牆靠機械，拆城邦體系靠火與人質。

kit.name: 羅馬弩砲
kit.history: 扭力弩砲，一發一具箭。羅馬用它拆掉希臘的城牆，也拆掉了希臘的城邦體系。

countries: 這場衝突是愛爾蘭王權在10世紀末的一次攤牌，交戰雙方清楚分明。布萊恩一方由兩個王國組成：蒙斯王國的布萊恩·博魯，以及米斯王國的王兼愛爾蘭至高王梅爾·謝克奈爾·麥克·多姆奈爾。兩人於997年在克朗費爾特附近的王家集會上訂下分治：布萊恩取得愛爾蘭南半部的統治權，梅爾·謝克奈爾保留北半部與至高王名號，並把先前從都柏林與倫斯特收押的人質交予布萊恩；998年布萊恩交出康諾特人質，同年兩人首次聯手對付都柏林的諾斯人。反方是倫斯特王國與都柏林的聯軍：倫斯特由馬爾·穆爾達·麥克·穆爾哈德領軍，都柏林則以西格特里格·西爾克比亞德為首，其兄弟阿哈爾特亦死於此役，另有諾斯貴族庫伊倫·麥克·艾蒂根陣亡。倫斯特人歷來既抗拒烏伊·奈伊系的至高王凌駕，也不願接受蒙斯特王入主，這正是他們在999年末願與都柏林諾斯人結盟的原因。愛爾蘭方面的指揮結構是鬆散的「王—附王」制：國王只直接指揮本部族兵，附王憑血緣或誓約隨軍，沒有常備指揮部與統一後勤；都柏林一方則是城邦體制，諾斯王權兼有世襲與選舉，市有議會，另有城防守備與海運，兩套體系的落差正是此役的關鍵所在。
countriesEn: This clash was the showdown of the Irish kingship at the end of the tenth century, and the two sides are clearly defined. Boru's side was made up of two kingdoms: Brian Boru's kingdom of Munster, and the kingdom of Meath under its king and Ireland's high king, Máel Sechnaill mac Domnaill. The two men had met at a royal gathering near Clonfert in 997 and agreed a division of the island: Boru received rule over the southern half, Máel Sechnaill kept the northern half and the high kingship, and handed over to Boru the hostages he had been holding from Dublin and Leinster; in 998 Boru handed over the hostages of Connacht, and in that same year the two first acted together against the Norse of Dublin. The opposing side was an alliance of the kingdom of Leinster and the kingdom of Dublin: Leinster was led by Máel Mórda mac Murchada, while Dublin was headed by Sigtrygg Silkbeard, whose brother Harald also died in the fighting, together with the Norse notable Cuilén son of Eitigén. The Leinster men had always resisted domination either by the Uí Néill overkings or by the king of Munster, and that is precisely why they were willing to ally with the Norse of Dublin in late 999. The Irish command structure was a loose arrangement of kings and sub-kings: a king commanded directly only the war-band of his own kindred, the sub-kings came to the field on the strength of blood ties or sworn obligation, and there was no permanent command staff and no unified logistics. The Dublin side worked as a city state: Norse kingship combined inheritance with election, the town had its own assembly, and there were an urban garrison and a sea route, and the gap between those two systems was the crux of the campaign.
people: 布萊恩·博魯是蒙斯特國王，此時正靠與米斯王的分治協議累積實力；格倫馬瑪一役他與梅爾·謝克奈爾聯軍出戰，俘虜馬爾·穆爾達，直到倫斯特人交出人質才將其釋放——這是愛爾蘭早期以人質代替長期佔領的政治慣例首次被如此清楚地寫入編年。守方領袖馬爾·穆爾達·麥克·穆爾哈德是倫斯特的實際統帥，他與都柏林之王西格特里格·西爾克比亞德結盟，一同捲入這場在999年末爆發的起義。陣亡的對方將領有西格特里格之弟阿哈爾特，編年作「阿哈爾特，阿姆萊布之子」，傳統說他是丹麥王之子，退兵時被殺，葬於克瑞赫爾佩；利萊恩人庫伊倫·麥克·艾蒂根亦死於此役。編年同時承認布萊恩一方亦有大量傷亡，12世紀的愛爾蘭—諾斯戰爭史詩《Cogadh Gaedhel re Gallaibh》說卡薩爾氏族有眾多人倒下。戰後的人事更替最能說明這一役的份量：倫斯特王位改由烏伊·敦查德系的敦查德·麥克·多姆奈爾取得，至1003年被廢；西格特里格北走，先投烏伊萊德、再投凱內爾·奈奧因，皆無容身之地，最終折返向布萊恩交出人質、復位都柏林；布萊恩將自己與前妻所生的女兒嫁給他，又迎娶西格特里格的母親、結過三次婚的戈姆弗萊絲，把姻親與人質編織成新的秩序。
peopleEn: Brian Boru was king of Munster, and at this moment he was accumulating power on the strength of his division agreement with the king of Meath. At Glenumma he campaigned alongside Máel Sechnaill and took Máel Mórda prisoner, releasing him only when the Leinster men gave hostages: this is the first time the early Irish practice of substituting hostages for permanent occupation is written into the annals so plainly. The leader on the defending side was Máel Mórda mac Murchada, the practical commander of Leinster, who had allied with the king of Dublin, Sigtrygg Silkbeard, and was drawn into the revolt that broke out in late 999. Among the opposing commanders who fell was Harald, a brother of Sigtrygg, whom the annals record as Aralt son of Amhlaeibh and whom tradition calls a son of the king of the Danes, killed during the retreat and buried at Cryhelpe; Cuilén son of Eitigén of the Gailenga also died in the battle. The annals concede heavy losses on Boru's side as well, and the twelfth-century war romance Cogadh Gaedhel re Gallaibh says that many of the Dál gCais fell. The changes of personnel after the battle show best of all what the victory was worth: the kingship of Leinster was handed to Dúnchad son of Domnail of the Uí Dúnchada, who held it until he was deposed in 1003; Sigtrygg fled north, first to the Ulaid and then to Cenél nEógain, found no refuge in either, and finally came back, gave hostages to Boru and was restored to Dublin; Boru married his own daughter by his first wife to him, and took as his second wife Gormflaith, the thrice-married mother of Sigtrygg, weaving kinship and hostages into a new order.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬弩砲（Scorpio，即扭力弩砲）是公元前50年前後的羅馬軍械：木製機身、扭力絞盤儲能，一次裝填只發一發石彈或加重箭體，靠遠程投射在城牆上撕開缺口；羅馬人用它在希臘與小亞細亞拆城牆，同時拆掉希臘的城邦體系。它與本場戰爭相隔一千零四十九年，並不在999年愛爾蘭的戰場上，但它對應的命題正在此役重演：拆掉一個城邦體系。真實的攻城手段與羅馬完全不同——布萊恩的部隊在元旦前後進入都柏林城防時並無遇到太大抵抗，沒有投石機、沒有撞木、沒有雲梯的記載，有的只是奇襲入城、火攻與拆解人質制度。愛爾蘭各軍的骨幹仍是矛兵：長身矛列成縱隊與橫線，中央矛列以盾牆護住身體，兩翼是攜弓與投石索的輕裝步兵；投石索是愛爾蘭人最具代表性的武器，一條皮帶繫石，拋擲有專門訓練的節奏與射程。冷兵器除青銅矛頭與斧之外，還有愛爾蘭式直刃長劍，劍身窄長而利於刺穿；護具以皮甲為主，頭戴皮革加金屬箍的頭盔，配木盾與編得緻密的藤盾。都柏林的諾斯人除斧、矛、劍外，還有狹長的維京海上戰船，既能沿東岸把援兵與穀物運進城內，也能在得手之後橫掠沿岸。圍城與破城的真正器械是火：編年記下元旦焚燒都柏林聚落與利夫河北岸的聖林凱爾·托梅爾——羅馬砲手改的是城牆，愛爾蘭人改的是城邦的經濟與宗教結構。
kitsEn: The Roman scorpio on the card is a piece of Roman military engineering of about 50 BC: a wooden frame storing energy in a torsion skein, loaded for a single shot of stone or a heavy arrow bolt, breaking the wall by long-range impact. The Romans used it to break the walls of the Greek cities and of Asia Minor, and with them they dismantled the Greek system of city-states. It stands one thousand and forty-nine years away from this war and was not present on any Irish field in 999, but the proposition it represents was being reenacted here: the dismantling of a city state. The real means of taking the city were nothing like the Roman ones. Brian's men entered the defences of Dublin around the turn of the year and met no great resistance; there is no record of a stone-thrower, a ram or a ladder, only a surprise entry, fire, and the breaking up of the hostage system. The backbone of the Irish armies remained the spearmen: long spears drawn up in columns and lines, the central rank covered by a wall of shields, and on the flanks lighter men with bows and slings. The sling was the most characteristic Irish weapon, a thong with a stone at the end, thrown to a trained rhythm and range. Among the cold arms, besides bronze spearheads and axes, was the narrow straight Irish sword, built to thrust; armour was chiefly leather, with helmets of leather bound with metal, and they carried wooden shields and tight-woven wicker shields. The Norse of Dublin, besides axes, spears and swords, had the narrow Viking sea-ships, which could bring reinforcements and grain in along the east coast and then sweep the coast after a victory. The real instrument of the siege was fire: the annals record the burning of the settlement of Dublin and of the grove of Caill Tomair on the north bank of the Liffey on the Kalends of January. Where the Roman gunners changed the wall, the Irish changed the economic and religious structure of the city state.
tactics: 格倫馬瑪的戰術核心是地形與追殲的配合。此地是通往都柏林的一道山口，愛爾蘭中世紀史家艾爾比·麥克·沙姆雷恩指出戰場就在希伯尼亞諾斯王國邊緣、距都柏林一日行程之內；布萊恩的聯軍在此截住正沿公路北上的倫斯特—都柏林聯軍。兩軍在狹窄谷地接戰，聯軍在至少三個方向被突破，全軍潰散；追擊之中，主力在利夫河幾處淺灘重新結集時被屠殺——地形在此同時發揮兩種作用：谷地限制對方能展開的兵力，河道則提供了逐批殲滅的場所。編年說得很直接：主要將領不是陣亡就是被俘，馬爾·穆爾達被布萊恩扣作人質籌碼。奪路而出的追擊緊接著就是攻城：布萊恩當日即向都柏林推進，於除夕抵達城郊，翌年元旦入城、焚燒聚落與聖林，之後在二月初撤出，佔領時間短得不合常理，說明這場勝利靠的是奇襲與人心，而不是長期圍城。整場戰役沒有任何攻城器械的記載，也沒有大型圍城：這正是10世紀末愛爾蘭戰爭的樣貌——在當時襲擊隊通常只有一兩百人的尺度上，勝敗在幾個小時內決定。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of Glenumma was terrain combined with pursuit. The place was a gap on the road to Dublin; the medieval Irish historian Ailbhe Mac Shamhráin placed the battlefield on the edge of the Hiberno-Norse kingdom, within a day's march of the city, and it was there that Boru's coalition intercepted the Leinster-Dublin army moving north along the road. The two armies met in a narrow valley, the coalition was broken through in at least three directions, and the whole force dissolved; in the pursuit, the main body was slaughtered when it rallied at several fording points along the River Liffey. The ground did double duty: the valley restricted how many of the enemy could be deployed, and the river supplied the places where the broken could be destroyed in batches. The annals put it plainly: the principal commanders were killed or captured, and Máel Mórda was held by Brian as a pledge. The pursuit ran straight into the assault on the city. Brian moved on Dublin at once, reached its outskirts on New Year's Eve, entered the city on the Kalends of January, burned the settlement and the grove, and then withdrew in early February; an occupation that short is out of all proportion, and it shows the victory rested on surprise and on the mood of the town rather than on a protracted siege. There is no record of any siege engine anywhere in the campaign, and no great siege at all. This is what warfare in late tenth-century Ireland looked like: on the scale where a raiding party was generally a hundred or two hundred men, the outcome was settled within a few hours.
data: 可查證的數字如下，並附出處。日期最明確：《烏爾斯特編年》記999年12月30日、星期四交戰，《因尼斯法倫編年》則把都柏林被奪記於1000年1月1日；《四部注釋師年表》與《蘇格蘭編年史》同載此事，前者另有此戰最長的編年記載。傷亡數字互相矛盾：《因尼斯法倫編年》說愛爾蘭的外族中最精銳者盡歿於此，12世紀《Cogadh Gaedhel re Gallaibh》誇稱自七世紀馬格拉特戰役以來未有更大屠殺，同時也承認卡薩爾氏族有大量死傷；後世彙編（MacManus, p.276）稱七千名諾斯人陣亡。史家提醒，當時的襲擊隊通常只有一兩百人，七千這個數字顯係詩化誇大，不宜當作實數。兵力方面，雙方人數均為不詳，編年只寫「大軍」。唯一成組的傷亡數字出現在1014年克朗塔夫之戰的編年記錄：諾斯一方約七百五十人，愛爾蘭一方約二百五十人。戰場位置亦有考訂：19世紀的奧多諾萬與托德曾把戰場定在威克洛郡鄧拉文一帶，1914年約瑟夫·勞埃德改指基爾代爾郡阿德克勞，2001年艾爾比·麥克·沙姆雷恩沿用此說，戰場落在溫德米爾山與布萊克徹赤之間，條目採納此說，座標約北緯53度16分、西經6度31分。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are given below with their sources. The dating is the firmest element of all: the Annals of Ulster place the battle on Thursday, 30 December 999, while the Annals of Innisfallen record the taking of Dublin on 1 January 1000; the Annals of the Four Masters and the Chronicon Scotorum both carry the event, and the former holds the longest annalistic account of it. The casualty figures contradict one another. The Annals of Innisfallen say that the best part of the foreigners of Ireland fell in it; the twelfth-century Cogadh Gaedhel re Gallaibh boasts that no greater slaughter had occurred since the seventh-century Battle of Magrath, while admitting at the same time that many of the Dál gCais fell; a later compilation (MacManus, p. 276) gives seven thousand Norse dead. As historians warn, raiding armies of the time generally numbered a hundred or two hundred men, so the figure of seven thousand is plainly poetic exaggeration and should not be treated as a real count. On strength, the numbers of both sides are given as unknown, the annals saying only a great army. The only set of casualty figures in a pair comes from the annalistic entry for the battle of Clontarf in 1014: about seven hundred and fifty of the foreigners and about two hundred and fifty of the Irish. The site of the battle too has been argued over. In the nineteenth century John O'Donovan and James Henthorn Todd were tempted to place it near Dunlavin in County Wicklow, but in 1914 Joseph Lloyd moved it to Ardclough in County Kildare, and Ailbhe Mac Shamhráin followed that in 2001, locating the fight between Windmill Hill and Blackchurch; the coordinates given are roughly 53 degrees 16 minutes north, 6 degrees 31 minutes west.
cause: 起因是10世紀末愛爾蘭王權的雙重危機。997年布萊恩與梅爾·謝克奈爾在克朗費爾特會面訂約分治，兩位王各得一半，名義上的至高王卻只有一個；998年兩人首次聯手對付都柏林的諾斯人，把都柏林——這座控制愛爾蘭門戶與海外貿易的希伯尼亞諾斯城邦——變成共同目標。但倫斯特人自有算盤：他們歷來既不服烏伊·奈伊系的至高王凌駕，也不願接受蒙斯特王的入主，於是999年末，當布萊恩的勢力伸到倫斯特境內、企圖更緊地控制都柏林時，倫斯特人與都柏林的諾斯人反而結盟，爆發一場短命的起義。四部注釋師年表在999年條下還留下一段預言詩，說他們將來到格倫馬瑪，飲下致命的酒，都柏林這座美城將在劫掠之後被焚燒——這段詩說明編年家從一開始就把這一役當作劫掠都柏林的前哨。直接導火索是布萊恩對兩地控制力的加緊：戰後他把敦查德·麥克·多姆奈爾立為倫斯特王，把人質制度一路帶到都柏林，又以婚姻綁住城邦的王。於是反彈必然在下一個世代再起，那正是1014年由倫斯特與都柏林聯手發動、終於在克朗塔夫爆發的第二次起義。
causeEn: The cause lies in a double crisis of the Irish kingship at the end of the tenth century. In 997 Boru and Máel Sechnaill met at Clonfert and agreed a division of the island: two kings, each with half, but only one high kingship in name. In 998 they acted together against the Norse of Dublin for the first time, making Dublin, the Hiberno-Norse city state that held the gate of Ireland and its overseas trade, a common target. But Leinster had its own arithmetic: the Leinstermen had always refused the overlordship of the Uí Néill high kings and would not accept the king of Munster either, so when in late 999 Boru's reach extended into Leinster and his grip on Dublin tightened, Leinster and the Norse of Dublin allied instead and a short-lived revolt broke out. The Annals of the Four Masters preserve under the entry for 999 a verse of prophecy, saying that they would come to Gleann-Mama, would drink a deadly draught there, and that the fair city of Ath-cliath would be burned after the ravaging of the Leinster plain. The verse shows that the annalists understood the engagement from the outset as the opening move of an enterprise to sack Dublin. The immediate spark was Boru's tightening hold: afterwards he set up Dúnchad son of Domnail as king of Leinster, carried the hostage system into Dublin, and bound the city to himself by marriage. Rebellion was therefore certain to return in the next generation, and it did, in the second rising of 1014 in which Leinster and Dublin fought together and which came to a head at Clontarf.
impact: 這場起義失敗了，但它把布萊恩的權力推上一級。戰後都柏林被攻破焚燒，西格特里格被逐出城，北走投靠不成，只好回來交出人質、復位；從此這位希伯尼亞諾斯之王要靠蒙斯特宗主才能保住王位。愛爾蘭編年史家艾爾比·麥克·沙姆雷恩直言，格倫馬瑪的長期受益者只有布萊恩一人：這場勝利不只在軍事上打通了通往都柏林的路，更在心理上壓過了塔拉之王，幫他撕毀了克朗費爾特協議，使都柏林被綁進蒙斯特的勢力圈至少一個世紀。倫斯特王位則改由敦查德·麥克·多姆奈爾取得，至1003年被廢；倫斯特此後在名分上臣服、實質上仍握軍力，才在十餘年後孕育出與都柏林聯手的那場更大反叛。從更長的歷史看，格倫馬瑪是愛爾蘭至高王從稱號變成實權的轉折點：1000年布萊恩進軍塔拉，因前鋒被米斯王擊破而未戰而退；1002年他率同一批聯軍進至阿索恩，取得康諾特與米斯的人質，成為無爭議的至高王；1014年克朗塔夫一役更把諾斯人在愛爾蘭的勢力連根拔起。而這一切的第一塊骨牌，正是999年這一役。
impactEn: The revolt failed, but it lifted Brian's power one more step. Dublin was sacked and burned, Sigtrygg was driven out of his city, and when he could find no refuge in the north he came back, gave hostages and was restored; from then on the Hiberno-Norse king held his crown from a Munster overlord. The Irish annalistic historian Ailbhe Mac Shamhráin put it bluntly: the only long-term beneficiary of Glenumma was Brian himself. The victory opened the road to Dublin militarily and, just as importantly, gave him a psychological advantage over the king of Tara, helped him break the Agreement of Clonfert, and tied Dublin into the sphere of Leth Moga for at least a century to come. The kingship of Leinster passed instead to Dúnchad son of Domnail, who was deposed in 1003; Leinster thereafter submitted in name while still holding troops in its own right, and that was the soil from which the far greater rising of a decade later grew. In the longer view Glenumma is the turning point at which the Irish high kingship stopped being a title and became actual power: in 1000 Brian marched on Tara and withdrew without battle after his advance guard was destroyed; in 1002 he brought the same coalition to Athlone, took the hostages of Connacht and Meath, and stood unchallenged as high king; in 1014 the battle of Clontarf broke Norse power in Ireland altogether. The first domino of that whole sequence was set down in 999.
result: 格倫馬瑪一役以布萊恩與梅爾·謝克奈爾聯軍的大勝告終：倫斯特—都柏林聯軍在山口被衝散至三個方向，追擊中主力在利夫河淺灘被屠殺，主要將領非死即俘，馬爾·穆爾達被俘，阿哈爾特與庫伊倫陣亡；布萊恩隨即進軍都柏林，於除夕抵達、元旦入城，焚燒聚落與聖林凱爾·托梅爾，掠走財貨後在二月初撤出，實際佔領約一週。西格特里格被逐出都柏林，之後折返交出人質、復位，並迎娶布萊恩之女；布萊恩則迎娶西格特里格之母戈姆弗萊絲，把城邦的自主權改造成人質與姻親的網。起義方付出的代價是全面屈服：倫斯特另立新王，人質制度上門，實際的抵抗要等到1014年才重新爆發，並以克朗塔夫之役的崩潰收場——布萊恩陣亡、諾斯聯盟瓦解、馬爾·穆爾達再度陣亡。從編年家的角度，999年是聯盟中的城邦抵抗單一王權的最後一次成功企圖，此後愛爾蘭進入以蒙斯特王為中心的至高王時代。
resultEn: Glenumma ended in a crushing victory for the coalition of Boru and Máel Sechnaill. The Leinster-Dublin army was broken through in three directions in the gap; in the pursuit its main body was slaughtered at the fording points of the Liffey; the principal commanders were killed or captured; Máel Mórda was taken prisoner, and Harald and Cuilén were among the dead. Brian marched on Dublin at once, reached the city on New Year's Eve, entered it on the Kalends of January, burned the settlement and the grove of Caill Tomair, and after carrying off the wealth of the trading town withdrew in early February, occupying it in practice for about a week. Sigtrygg was expelled, then returned, gave hostages and was restored, and married Brian's daughter; Brian took as his second wife Gormflaith, Sigtrygg's mother, and so converted the autonomy of the city state into a web of hostages and marriage. The rebels paid for the rising with complete submission: Leinster was given a new king, the hostage system was imposed, and real resistance did not return until 1014, when it ended in the collapse of Clontarf, with Brian killed, the Norse alliance broken and Máel Mórda dead for a second time. In the annalists' judgement, 999 was the last successful attempt by a city state in league to resist a single royal power, and what followed in Ireland was the age of the Munster king as high king.
